description: This file defines internal interfaces and classes related to client gateway observation in Orleans. It manages gateway notifications sent to clients and includes methods for stopping message sending to specific gateways, as well as retrieving observer instances.

classes.name: ClientGatewayObserver
classes.description: Implements the client gateway observation logic, allowing notifications to be sent to clients and managing gateway states.

methods.name: StopSendingToGateway
methods.description: Signals a client to stop sending messages to the specified gateway.

methods.name: GetObserverGrainId
methods.description: Retrieves the observer grain ID for a given client ID.

methods.name: GetObserver
methods.description: Retrieves the observer instance for a specific client using the grain factory and client ID.
